Description: Pistachio-kataifi is spreading from the Dubai chocolate bar into chewy cookies, pistachio drinks and frappe mixes, with cafes reporting heavy demand. Grocery opportunity is in next-format SKUs (cookies, spreads, drink mixes, frozen desserts) at premium price points before supermarket dupes saturate.

Hojicha lattes are showing up across UAE cafes and trade press is tipping it as the successor to matcha, with milder bitterness and a caramel profile. Opportunity in RTD bottles, powders and tea bags, though supply scaling is a risk.

Protein and energy bars are the fastest-growing sports nutrition category in the UAE, with protein callouts spreading into cookies and chips. Opportunity in better-for-you snack ranges and multipacks priced for repeat purchase.

Mochi, marshmallow-centred cookies, jelly toppings and wobbly custards are rising as texture becomes a content hook. Opportunity in frozen mochi, jelly desserts and chilled wobbly desserts that suit delivery.

Trend: Tissue bread / paratha / karak chai comfort food
Description: Karak chai toast with tissue bread and paratha burgers are cited as viral Dubai cafe eats. Opportunity in frozen paratha, tissue bread and karak chai mixes as convenient at-home formats.
